newsitem.title: UK: Base metals end off lows, but LME sentiment poor.
newsitem.headline: Base metals end off lows, but LME sentiment poor.

text.p: ALUMINIUM - Closes easier, just above $1,390 fresh 2-1/4 year low. Outlook gloomy, with stocks rising and consumers withdrawn.
COPPER - Ends above lows, but soft and adrift of $1,900.
NICKEL - Finishes with pared losses after partial rally.
TIN - Above six-month low of $6,000 at close. Still easier.
LEAD/ZINC - Off lows at close, but still soft. ALLOY - Dull.
